subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: After the durable replay fix is reviewed, should this issue track only the WhatsApp ingress replay/completion bug, or also require a new operator inspect/drain/ack surface before closure?
rationale: The central outage is a bug, but the requested operator verb and defensive replay policy are new product surface that current source does not define.

options.title: Scope To Durable Replay
options.body: Keep this issue open for the WhatsApp durable replay/completion bug and handle operator drain/ack as a separate maintainer-sponsored item if still needed.

options.title: Require Operator Recovery Here
options.body: Do not close this issue until the fix also adds a supported inspect/drain/ack path for channel ingress rows.

options.title: Close After Candidate PR
options.body: Close this issue when the linked candidate PR lands, and ask reporters to file a new issue if completed runs still leave pending ingress rows.

recommendation.title: Scope To Durable Replay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the WhatsApp durable replay/completion bug and handle operator drain/ack as a separate maintainer-sponsored item if still needed.
